p3.title: Baked Penne with Coconut Milk and Spinach
p3.instructions:
Cook penne.
Saute onion in oil.
Stir in spinach and coconut milk.
Combine with pasta and bake 20 minutes.
Serve warm.

t3.title: Shakshuka
t3.instructions:
Heat oil and saute onion and pepper.
Add garlic and spices.
Add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Make wells and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook until the eggs set.
Garnish with parsley.

t7.title: Peanut Noodles
t7.instructions:
Cook spaghetti.
Whisk sauce.
Toss together.

b1.title: Banana Bread
b1.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Mash bananas and mix with butter.
Stir in sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Sprinkle baking soda and salt, then fold in flour.
Pour into a loaf pan.
Bake for 60 minutes.

b2.title: Vegan Banana Bread
b2.instructions:
Preheat oven.
Mash bananas, mix in oil and applesauce.
Stir in sugar then dry ingredients.
Bake 55 minutes.

pc1.title: Penn Cove Mussels with Salmon
pc1.instructions:
Steam the mussels in wine.
Serve.

c1.title: Chicken Alfredo
c1.instructions:
Cook pasta.
Make sauce from butter, cream and cheese.
Add chicken and pasta.

c2.title: Cashew Cream Pasta
c2.instructions:
Blend cashews, water, garlic and lemon to a cream.
Toss with cooked pasta.

x1.title: Plain Omelet
x1.instructions:
Whisk eggs.
Cook in butter.
Fold and serve.

x3.title: Plain Omelet
x3.instructions:
Whisk eggs.
Cook in butter.
Fold and serve.
